question: For each year, which driver and which constructor scored the most points? I want the full name of each driver.
sql:
WITH driver_yearly AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        ds.driver_id,
        SUM(ds.points) AS total_points
    FROM driver_standings ds
    JOIN races r ON ds.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, ds.driver_id
),
ranked_drivers AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        driver_id,
        total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rn
    FROM driver_yearly
),
constructor_yearly AS (
    SELECT 
        r.year,
        cs.constructor_id,
        SUM(cs.points) AS total_points
    FROM constructor_standings cs
    JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
    GROUP BY r.year, cs.constructor_id
),
ranked_constructors AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        constructor_id,
        total_points,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY year ORDER BY total_points DESC) AS rn
    FROM constructor_yearly
)
SELECT 
    year,
    'Driver' AS entity_type,
    forename || ' ' || surname AS name,
    total_points
FROM ranked_drivers rd
JOIN drivers d ON rd.driver_id = d.driver_id
WHERE rd.rn = 1

UNION ALL

SELECT 
    year,
    'Constructor' AS entity_type,
    c.name AS name,
    total_points
FROM ranked_constructors rc
JOIN constructors c ON rc.constructor_id = c.constructor_id
WHERE rc.rn = 1

ORDER BY year, entity_type
